summary: BGM Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its extraordinary general meeting held on September 5, 2026. Shareholders representing 273,457,527 of 400,623,358 outstanding shares constituted a quorum, and all resolutions were passed. The filing does not disclose the specific resolutions or their terms; it references the meeting notice of August 11, 2026, for details. This is a routine disclosure of shareholder meeting results, with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring identified. The registrant is the filer reporting corporate governance outcomes. What to watch: future filings may disclose material actions approved, but this report itself is not a special situation.
